summary: Iteration 37 · Full verification of MediCar Plus Sync Multi-PC after _apiBase() fix + new POST /api/sync/admin/reset-devices endpoint. Backend: 7/7 pytest scenarios PASS covering (a) MASTER cycle: reset → PC1/PC2 authorized → PC3 rejected → reset frees slots (b) reset-devices 403 admin_only for wrong key (c) 404 target_not_found for inexistent license (d) admin/list-licenses returns real licenses (>=1) for MASTER and 403 for fake (e) full Premium 2-PC push/pull/backup round-trip (f) reset frees client license slots. Frontend: 3 scenarios verified in Playwright against the preview URL — (i) MASTER UI opens modal with all data-testids present (sync-btn-linked / sync-btn-independent / admin-target-select 30 options / admin-send-to-license / sync-send-backup) and admin purple block visible; (ii) PREMIUM client UI (real JWT of test29@example.com) shows 'Tu plan Premium permite 2 ordenadores', backup button visible, admin block ABSENT, backup send click → toast 'Enviada'; (iii) friendly error modal appears with 'Sincronización cargando' + Reintentar + Cerrar buttons (no alert()) when no license in localStorage. All test sync_devices cleaned up via reset-devices for MASTER and Premium client.
critical_code_review_comments: sync.py:504-518 admin_reset_devices correctly enforces MASTER_KEY check → 403 admin_only, and _find_license → 404 target_not_found. Removes by (license_key_hash, install_id) when install_id provided, else clears all devices for that license. Returns removed count. Clean, idempotent, safe.

sync.py:130-134 AdminResetDevicesBody uses Pydantic min_length=10 → very short fake keys get 422 (validation) instead of 403. Not a security issue (still rejected) but if you want a uniform 403 for wrong admin key, validate length after the MASTER_KEY check. Same note applies to admin_push_to_license.
v2.html _apiBase() fix confirmed: friendly error modal ('Sincronización cargando' + Reintentar/Cerrar) appears when no license — no crash, no alert(). Behavior matches iteration_35/36 fix.
Premium UI correctly hides the admin cross-license block when license is not MASTER (verified: sel_admin element does not exist in DOM for the PREMIUM JWT of test29@example.com).

The v2.html initial 'pull HTTP 409' console error observed when device is fresh (independent mode) is expected: /api/sync/pull returns 409 device_mode_independent by design until user opts into 'Fusionado'. Not an issue.
